ImageDescription.value: A candlelight vigil-protest of thousands of people was held on the large main street Sejong-daero in Jung-gu, Seoul near Seoul City Hall for the victims of the Seoul Halloween crowd crush at the end of the mourning period on Saturday, November 5, 2022. It was held by the progressive group Candlelight Action, who have held prior regular protests against the government of President Yoon Suk-yeol, and was based at City Hall Subway Station, Exit 7, starting at 5:00 p.m. The sign on the organizer's tent at the subway exit is partially blocked by a man's head but reads something to this effect in English, "Irresponsible government caused a disaster." In the foreground is one of the many street candle sellers.

Artist.value:
Bonnielou2013

 This photo was taken with Samsung Galaxy S20+ 5G
